projects.title: IoT-Based Fire Monitoring & Cloud-Native Analytics Platform
projects.detailed_context: University thesis project — a production-grade cloud-native IoT platform built entirely solo. Infrastructure provisioned on DigitalOcean Kubernetes Service (DOKS) using a 4-layer Terraform architecture with isolated remote state backends per environment (dev/prod) in DO Spaces. The 4 layers are: 00-bootstrap (state bucket setup), 01-infra (VPC, DOKS cluster, DNS), 02-platform (Helm: ArgoCD, ingress-nginx, cert-manager), 03-argocd (root App-of-Apps manifest, GitHub App bot credentials). Data pipeline: physical/simulated ESP32 MCUs → Mosquitto MQTT broker → Telegraf (json_v2 parser) → InfluxDB v2 (time-series) → Python pandas ETL worker (5-minute downsampling + 30-minute anomaly debouncing with upsert logic) → PostgreSQL (relational analytics + incident lifecycle). API layer: Node.js / Express.js with persistent sessions via connect-pg-simple (survives pod restarts), prom-client Prometheus instrumentation, and Nginx auth_request gating for Grafana embedding. CI/CD: 4-stage GitHub Actions — Stage 0 path-filter (dorny/paths-filter), Stage 1 matrix build + Trivy CVE scan + GHCR push, Stage 2a dev auto-deploy (kustomize edit + commit), Stage 2b prod promotion PR (peter-evans/create-pull-request with GitHub App short-lived tokens). GitOps: ArgoCD reconciles Kustomize base/overlay manifests (17+ K8s objects: Deployments, StatefulSets, DaemonSets, Jobs, PVCs, Ingress, NetworkPolicies). Zero-downtime migrations: Flyway runs as K8s Job at sync-wave:5, app pods at sync-wave:10. Zero-Trust: default-deny NetworkPolicies micro-segment all pod traffic. Observability: Prometheus + Grafana Alloy DaemonSet + Loki + 6 custom Grafana dashboards (API perf, Loki errors, cluster health, MQTT broker, PostgreSQL health, fire telemetry).

projects.title: Jobflow — Personal Autonomous Job Pipeline & AI Resume Builder
projects.detailed_context: Personal full-stack Python project. Built to fully automate the job search pipeline: paste any job URL → AI extracts structured job data → AI scores it against your career profile → AI generates a tailored, ATS-optimized PDF resume. Tech stack: FastAPI (Python 3.10+), PostgreSQL via SQLAlchemy ORM + Alembic migrations (SQLite for local dev), Google Gemini API (v1beta) with 4-model fallback chain, Playwright headless Firefox for SPA job scraping with bot-bypass, BeautifulSoup4 for HTML parsing, Jinja2 templates, TailwindCSS frontend, WeasyPrint for PDF generation (Garamond/Georgia typography), JWT auth (python-jose), Docker + Docker Compose. Key technical design: Master Profile stores career history at bullet-level granularity (each bullet as separate DB row) enabling precise AI retrieval. Context Builder assembles the full profile into a structured Markdown document for the AI. Resume Tailor uses Fact-Anchored prompting — AI strictly forbidden from inventing skills or metrics; rephrases only what exists in the profile. Over-generates 6-8 bullets per experience for user curation. Pydantic v2 validates all AI output before returning to the UI. The interactive Builder lets users add/remove/edit every bullet before PDF export.
